key.name: latitude
key.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). A value of 91.0 indicates the coordinate has not been configured.

key.name: longitude
key.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). A value of 181.0 indicates the coordinate has not been configured.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often the planetary positions are recalculated, in seconds.
